u du 'bar ba mchod rten nag po dran chog
item.coloph: sde brgyad nang 'thab mchod rten nag po drag chog zlog pa 'di/ phas kyi g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phyir/ bstan pa srung ba'i gdams pa yin/ rin chen sa la gter du sbas/ mnga' bdag rje'i phyag tu gtad/ bdag 'dra li shu stag rings gi/ stag gzig skad la bod skad bsgyur dug sbrul tshang ma'i 'khris phyung nas/ ka ri ka la byar gyis bris/ phyi rabs las can cig dang 'phrad par shog 'phrad nas bon gyi bstan pa srung bar shog dam ldan ma gtogs pa la byin na chad pa gnyen po chod cig sa ma ya//

item.tib: u du 'bar ba mchod rten nag po'i dran chog
